doctrine: Corrections appended, never edited. A body that publishes when its own number was wrong is the only kind a relying party can depend on. Measurement, not certification — a correction is an asset, not an admission.
note: Seed feed: nine real self-caught corrections from the 19-20 Aug session + ledger entries. Append-only; entries are signed by their evidence.

corrections.title: Axis-count drift — '16 axes' served publicly
corrections.what_was_wrong: An internal signed artifact carried '16 axes'; the live API served totals.axes=17 and items=966 while canon is 14-slot / 13 measured / 819 items.
corrections.how_caught: End-user probe of councilof.ai/api/gspc against the canon register (GR.2 reconciliation); cross-checked badge (13 of 14) vs API totals.
corrections.fix: Public copy holds 13-of-14 everywhere; the 16-axis artifact is internal-only and never publishes; the councilof-ai lane reconciled the API to axes=14 / measured=13 / DOI 21991104.
corrections.evidence: verified live: /api/gspc totals.axes=14, measured_axes=13, public_count '13 measured of 14'

corrections.title: Signed-card envelope divergence — kid absent from DID doc
corrections.what_was_wrong: The published agent-card.json carried kid did:web:csoai.org#site-release-1 which is absent from the DID document; the card did not verify against either published key (corrections #27 / HN.0).
corrections.how_caught: Offline verification of the served card against the DID doc keys (recomputed id + Ed25519 check).
corrections.fix: Byte-identical restore of the machine surface while the signing-chain fix is owned by the kernel/identity lane (Rekor v2 + RFC 3161 TSA). No new A2A publicity until it verifies.
corrections.evidence: kid #site-release-1 absent from did.json; signature invalid vs both published keys (recomputed)

corrections.title: Two-deployer clobber — full _site deploy dropped machine-surface files
corrections.what_was_wrong: A full _site build deployed to the shared csoai-site project replaced its content, dropping K3's untracked machine-surface files (agent-card.json, banks-manifest.json, verification.schema.json, CANONICAL-DOIS.md, badge/axes.json).
corrections.how_caught: Post-deploy machine-path probe: 5 of 12 paths 404'd on the new hash (csoai.org still showed 200 via edge cache — the cache masked it).
corrections.fix: Restored the authoritative files from the prior deployment, added a never-drop allowlist rule to build_site.py, redeployed; all machine paths verified 200 cache-busted.
corrections.evidence: verified 12/12 machine paths 200 on csoai.org + pages.dev after redeploy

corrections.title: Ghost API endpoints — arena feed documented path 404
corrections.what_was_wrong: The documented arena feed path councilof.ai/api/sov-arena/rounds.jsonl returned 404 while the live data served at /sov-arena/rounds.jsonl.
corrections.how_caught: End-user probe of both paths against the harness map's documented surface.
corrections.fix: Flagged to the K3 lane; the live feed serves at the working path and the KV-backed feed continues.

corrections.title: CEASAI CamelCase leak — codename case-drift on public copy
corrections.what_was_wrong: An internal codename appeared with a CamelCase variant on public surfaces, violating the case-locked kill-list (ceasai vs CEASAI).
corrections.how_caught: Case-sensitive sweep of public HTML for kill-list tokens (the sweep that also caught the BFT pages).
corrections.fix: Purged the variant from public copy; the kill-list sweep is now part of the acceptance battery.
corrections.evidence: case-sensitive grep across shipped _site; 0 hits post-purge

corrections.title: Pricing leak — SaaS tiers on public surfaces
corrections.what_was_wrong: Public surfaces carried SaaS pricing tiers (£199/mo re-attestation, £999/£1,999) — the single most dangerous sentence on the estate: it reads as pay-to-stay-measured.
corrections.how_caught: Canon sweep (HO.2 ruling: all pricing removed; verification free forever).
corrections.fix: All pricing removed; the free-rail posture line replaces it; any future pricing surface requires an owner ruling.
corrections.evidence: grep for £N/mo across shipped pages → 0 hits

corrections.title: Omnibus date drift — high-risk deferral mis-stated
corrections.what_was_wrong: The Annex III high-risk date needed to be 2 Dec 2027 (Digital Omnibus Reg (EU) 2026/1744 deferral), not 2 Aug 2026 — serving the dead date would be a credibility wound.
corrections.how_caught: Reg-calendar research + date sweep of shipped pages for wrong pairings of '2 Aug 2026' with Annex III.
corrections.fix: Verified no wrong pairing shipped (the 2 Aug 2026 refs are Article 50, correct); the reg-feed treats dates as corrected data, not static copy.
corrections.evidence: grep for 'Annex III'+'2 Aug 2026' across shipped pages → none

corrections.title: BFT/33-Agent pages shipping — kill-listed content reachable
corrections.what_was_wrong: tools/bft-council.html ('CSOAI Designed 33-Agent Council — Sovereign Governance') and tools/bft-vote-log.html shipped to production and sat in the sitemap — BFT/33/Sovereign are kill-listed.
corrections.how_caught: Kill-list sweep of shipped _site (the ramp's 'last 33-Agent string' valuation-hygiene item).
corrections.fix: NEVER_HTML exclusion (DIRS loop), _redirects 308 → honest desks, sitemap cleanup. Verified: routes 308, zero bft in sitemap, machine paths + hero intact.

corrections.title: CARE divergence — internal harness figure vs public board
corrections.what_was_wrong: CARE 0.895/F1 0.8976 was claimed as 'key verified' but it is an in-lane harness figure (tuned specialist on an internal bank); the public board number is care leader 0.535 (n=199).
corrections.how_caught: Probe of the live signed board against the claimed figure (deterministic grader, 15,580 rows).
corrections.fix: Rule: never cite 0.895/0.8976 as the CARE board figure; public = 0.535 (n=199). Internal harness numbers stay internal-only.
corrections.evidence: live /api/gspc care leader acc=0.535 n=199 vs claimed 0.895

corrections.title: CRA Art 14 reporting date — 2027-09-11 corrected to 2026-09-11
corrections.what_was_wrong: The regulation feed served CRA Art 14 reporting as 11 Sep 2027; the CRA (2024/2847) applies from 11 September 2026.
corrections.how_caught: Cross-check of the feed against the ecosystem map's verified deadline list during the insurer-suite execution.
corrections.fix: REG-008 date corrected to 2026-09-11; the feed's doctrine is exactly this — a wrong date becomes a published correction, never a hidden edit.
